title: 把纠错写进代码：Lauren Tan 谈怎样信任 Agent 的产出
title_en: Put the correction in the code: Lauren Tan on trusting what agents ship
summary: Lauren Tan 在 AI Engineer CODE 2026 上介绍了她的团队怎样在一个月交付上万个 PR 的同时维持质量。本文梳理她的信任金字塔与验证方法，对照她公开的 pstack 工作流，并讨论这些数字与做法的适用条件。
summary_en: At AI Engineer CODE 2026, Lauren Tan described how her team ships tens of thousands of pull requests a month without losing quality. This note walks through her trust pyramid and verification practices, checks them against her public pstack workflows, and looks at what the numbers and methods depend on.

title: Claude Code 团队怎样做代码审查
title_en: How the Claude Code team reviews code
summary: Claude Code 团队公开了自己的代码审查流程：以回滚和事故为护栏，尽量减少人工审查时间。本文梳理其中的分层检查、审查器的评测与收敛，并对照官方文档说明借鉴时需要注意的边界。
summary_en: The Claude Code team has described its review process: minimise human review time, with reverts and incidents as the guardrail. This note walks through the layered checks, how the reviewer itself is evaluated and made to converge, and what the public docs say about the limits.

title: Personal Agent：从完成任务到承担事务
title_en: Personal agents: from finishing tasks to carrying ongoing responsibilities
summary: 近两个月 Personal Agent 产品密集发布。本文从一篇产品定位分析出发，讨论个人代理在记忆、主动服务、长期执行与授权上需要解决的问题，以及如何评估它的真实价值。
summary_en: Personal agents have shipped in quick succession over the past two months. Starting from a product-positioning analysis, this note looks at what memory, proactivity, long-running execution, and authorization require, and how to judge the real value.

title: 从 DeepSeek Super-agent 看 Agent 的下一步
title_en: What DeepSeek’s Super-agent says about where agents go next
summary: DeepSeek 近期公开了 Super-agent 的设计文章与研究原型。本文分析这套设计的价值、尚待解决的问题，以及社区讨论中的主要分歧。
summary_en: DeepSeek recently published its Super-agent design and a research prototype. This note examines what the design offers, what remains unresolved, and where the community disagrees.
